subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these exact 14 upstream action revisions in workflows that mint tokens, access secrets, run Codex, scan code, and publish containers?
rationale: Selecting new third-party executable revisions for privileged workflows is a supply-chain trust decision that CI cannot resolve automatically, and the protected security label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Approve refreshed exact head
options.body: Rebase onto current main, require all exact-head guards and relevant workflow checks to finish acceptably, then approve the reviewed immutable SHAs.

options.title: Split privileged action groups
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker publishing, and scanning updates into narrower PRs if the combined trust review is too broad.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or pause the batch and allow replacement dependency PRs if the Dependabot access and repeated rebase cycle cannot produce a stable review head.

recommendation.title: Approve refreshed exact head
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, require all exact-head guards and relevant workflow checks to finish acceptably, then approve the reviewed immutable SHAs.
